abort.already_configured: This emitter already sends I Feel reports.
abort.no_infrared_emitters: No infrared emitter found. Set one up first (Broadlink, ESPHome, Shelly, ZHA or MQTT).

user.title: Send I Feel reports
user.description: Pick the infrared emitter that faces the air conditioner's receiver and the thermometer whose readings it should steer by.

data_description.infrared_emitter_entity_id: Must be in line of sight of the indoor unit's receiver.
data_description.temperature_sensor_entity_id: Reported in whole degrees Celsius, as the remote does.
data_description.climate_entity_id: The unit's climate entity (Gree Wi-Fi or Gree Infrared). With the Wi-Fi one the reports can be checked: its room temperature becomes the reported one. Its mode, set point and fan speed also go into the re-arm press.

data.send_on_change: Also send when the reading changes
data.only_when_on: Only while the unit is on

data_description.interval: The remote reports every few minutes; the unit drops I Feel if it hears nothing for a while.
data_description.offset: Added to the sensor's reading before rounding.

data.rearm_every_hours: Re-arm every (when it can't be checked)

data_description.verify: Compares the climate entity's room temperature with the last report.
data_description.auto_rearm: Sends a remote press with I Feel on. The unit beeps once. Off: a repair issue tells you instead.
data_description.rearm_every_hours: For units without Wi-Fi feedback. 0 = never.

press.name: Re-arm press
press.description: A press carries the unit's whole state. Mode and set point come from the climate entity; set the rest to what the unit has, or the press changes it.

data.fallback_set_point: Set point without a climate entity

not_following.title: {title}: the air conditioner ignores I Feel reports
not_following.description: The last {misses} reports weren't taken up ({rearms} re-arm presses sent). Check that the infrared emitter still faces the unit's receiver, then press Re-arm I Feel. This clears once the unit follows again.
